limits: Painted frames are sampled at a fixed physical time shared by all animations; an independently normalized timeline would not represent a real joint configuration.
Automated relative-joint motion, alpha bounds and aspect ratios do not establish visual anatomy. Every final frame requires an explicit visual verdict.
Finite dense sampling cannot establish absolute perfection at every possible time or every customization combination. Chromium/Edge only.
The routed enlarged proof harness blocks service workers. Actual publication bytes and returning-visitor cache upgrades require a separate production check.
